_note: SINGLE source of truth for every trading-session / order-window / schedule time (IST, 24h HH:MM). Read only through src/market/sessions.py — no other config file or code literal may define a session time. A missing or invalid file stops startup (no built-in defaults). markets.<m>.regular_session = live exchange session (REGULAR orders). amo = after-market-order window: opens amo.open the same evening and closes amo.close the next morning; between regular_session.close and amo.open (and amo.close and regular_session.open) NO order can be placed. entry_windows are half-open [start,end) inside the regular session; the evening/pre-open SWING entry windows are DERIVED from amo, never repeated here. allowed: ALL | SWING | ORB_ONLY | EXIT_ONLY. min_llm_confidence 0 = no requirement. Per-strategy intraday range/entry/exit windows in strategies/builtin/*.json may only NARROW these — validated at load. Add another exchange/segment as another block under markets.
